content:
Welcome to this episode of the 9to5Toys Midday Digest—Prime Day Aftermath Special. Although the big fall Prime Day deals have ended, Apple deals are still everywhere, and you can find the best picks right here today. These include the best-ever deal on AirPods Pro 3 still going strong, AirPods Max 2 down by US$120, and the M6 Mac mini hitting an all-time low with a US$150 discount. You'll also see the all-new Apple Watch Series 12 in every configuration still at its lowest price ever, M5 MacBook Air models straight off US$200, and official Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases continuing to hold at all-time lows. All this and more below.

Sony BRAVIA TVs are up to US$1,000 off at Amazon—OLED, mini-LED, and more

Amazon's Prime Day AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live at nearly 30% off; AirPods Max 2 also still down US$120

Just look at how many items were on sale yesterday—now that Amazon's 2026 fall Prime Day has wrapped, most have gone back up in price. Apple gear is a different story, though: you can still grab AirPods Pro 3 at one of their lowest prices ever, plus a US$120 discount on AirPods Max 2.

As of the time of writing, Amazon is selling the Apple AirPods Pro 3 for US$179 with free shipping included.

This works out to nearly a 30% discount, making it one of the lowest prices we've seen since we started tracking these world-favourite earbuds.

Down from the usual US$249, that's a US$170 saving—how long this deal will last is anyone's guess. We've only seen Amazon sell them cheaper once: a fleeting US$169 offer during the four-day summer Prime Day back in late June, which was extremely hard to come by.

  • AirPods Pro 3 — US$179 (regular US$249)
  • AirPods Max 2 — US$429 (regular US$549)

Apple's AirPods Max 2, released earlier this year, is still sitting at its fall Prime Day pricing. Just like the Pro 3 above, we've only seen Amazon list it cheaper once—and right now this deal is just US$30 above that all-time low since the product first went on sale.

Now down by a total of US$120, Amazon continues to sell all five colours for US$429 with shipping included. There's no telling how long stock will last.

One of the best Prime Day deals of the year is still live: up to US$150 off the brand-new M6 Mac mini

The fall edition of Prime Day is officially over, but as we've reported, plenty of great afterglow deals are still going strong (for now, anyway). One of them is definitely Apple's just-released M6 Mac mini. As of writing, you can still pick one up for US$150 off, making it—if not the—then one of the best (hidden) Prime Day deals of the year.

As of this morning, Amazon still has a ton of hot Apple deals live, though some have started to disappear (mostly across the Apple Watch Series 12 configurations). How long these M6 Mac mini discounts will stick around is anyone's guess, but stock was still available as of this morning:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB — US$780 (regular US$899), just US$11 above its all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB — US$950 (regular US$1,099), all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB — US$1,150 (regular US$1,299), all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB — US$1,550 (regular US$1,699), all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio — US$2,300 (regular US$2,499), all-time low

Here's every configuration of the all-new Apple Watch Series 12 still at its Prime Day all-time low

Although the 2026 fall Prime Day has wrapped up, that doesn't mean it's completely over. Amazon is still offering holiday pricing on AirPods Pro 3, all-time lows on the M6 Mac mini, and deals across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup. Below, we've rounded up every model still sitting at the lowest price ever—some configurations have already started creeping back up, so act fast.
